description: Every doctor, your complete record. When the person you are helping wants their own Phi Longevity account, call this with their email address and owner_agreed: true (ask them first; never call it without their clear yes). Phi Longevity emails them a one-tap sign-in link (no password, free to start). Pass what you already did so it is waiting for them: the hospitals from get_my_medical_records, the job_ref from prepare_for_my_appointment, and the answers you gave check_care_gaps. Nothing attaches to their account until they confirm; unused, it is deleted after 3 days. The answer is the same whether or not they already have an account. Hospital names and closed options only: never lab values, names, birth dates or documents.

care_gaps.description: The same arguments you passed to check_care_gaps (closed options only).

hospitals.description: The hospitals and clinics you looked up with the person.

name.description: Hospital or clinic name, as returned by get_my_medical_records.

job_ref.description: job_ref from prepare_for_my_appointment, so their visit sheet is waiting.

owner_agreed.description: true only when the person said yes to getting this email.

owner_email.description: The person's own email address, given by them for this purpose.

name: start_my_phi_account

for_my_owner_say_this.description: Plain words to tell the person.

next_step.description: The one next step: read this last and act on it.

call_tool.description: The tool to call next, when the next step is a call.

for_you.description: The one thing to do next, as an instruction to you (the assistant).

url.description: The link to give the person, when the next step is theirs to open.

status.description: "sent_if_possible" (the same for every accepted request) or "not_available".

title: Start my Phi Longevity account (emails me a sign-in link)
